data.narrative:
EX-Fusion is a Series A nuclear energy company founded by Kazuki Matsuo, Shinsuke Fujioka, and Yoshitaka Mori that has raised $37M to date. The valuation analysis draws on a peer set of 11 comparable companies—3 public (OKLO, NNE, SMR) and 8 private entities including Fuse Energy, Helion, Valar Atomics, X-Energy, and Oklo—spanning seed through Series B stages within the nuclear energy sector.

Two valuation methods were applied. Stage-progression modeling uses the $37M raised as a base proxy and applies a 2.0x step-up multiplier typical of Series A-to-next-stage advancement, implying a $74M valuation. Peer-median analysis isolates three same-sector, same/adjacent-stage comparables (Fuse Energy at $200M Series A, Nano Nuclear Energy at $808M Seed, and Valar Atomics at $6.0B Series B), yielding a median valuation of $808M with a range spanning $200M to $6.0B.

Triangulation of these two methods supports a valuation range of $63M to $929M, with a median point of $441M. The wide dispersion reflects material uncertainty around stage-appropriate scaling within an early-stage, capital-intensive sector where peer valuations span nearly two orders of magnitude. Key uncertainties include technology maturity differentiation among peers and the appropriateness of applying Series B comparables to a Series A asset.
